items.title: Man found dead on Flinders Island believed to have been shot by officer, police say
items.standfirst: The sergeant, who was shot, fired his weapon a number of times after alleged ‘targeted’ attack outside island’s police stationGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastA police officer who was shot outside a remote Tasmanian police station is alleged to have shot and killed his attacker in response to what authorities believe was a “targeted” incident.Tasmania police deputy commissioner, Jonathan Higgins, said the sergeant Michael Preshaw had just come off shift at Whitemark police station on Flinders Island, which is north-east of the Tasmanian mainland. He had parked and gotten out of his police vehicle when he was shot at about 9.45pm on Saturday, Higgins told reporters on Sunday. Continue reading...
